_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for reader-facing ARTICLE SERIES (品牌系列). Before this file (2026-07-06), series identity lived only in title conventions + internal codenames + Telegram chat, so every session re-derived it from titles and guessed wrong (wrong name 迷思破解, under-scoped to 3, invented EP.X, picked a draft as the dup keeper). This registry is now the ONLY authoritative place for: which series exist, how each is branded, membership criteria, and current members. READ THIS — never re-derive a series from article titles.
_meta.root_cause_incident: docs/error_log.md 2026-07-06 迷思實驗室 series 4-mistake entry
_meta.governance: .claude/rules/publishing.md §系列/專題標題前綴慣例 points here as SoT
_meta.how_to_add_series: Add a key under `series` (see schema below). If title_prefix branding, set prefix + members. Update members whenever a new article joins. Then run `scripts/series_registry.py --apply`.
hard_rules: Branding mechanisms: 'title_prefix' (prefix 系列名｜ on the title, full-width ｜) OR 'frontend_masthead' (a dedicated frontend component renders the series identity; title carries NO prefix).
Separator is ALWAYS full-width ｜ (U+FF5C), never half-width | (reserved for 絕對值 |t| and tables).
Same-topic duplicates: keep exactly ONE 'published', set the rest to 'unpublished' (NEVER 'draft' — the release-pool re-releases drafts).
Before any content op (retitle / unpublish / dedup), VERIFY the article's `status` field (ground truth) — do NOT infer published-ness from `published_at` (a draft can carry a published_at).

myth_lab.definition: 拿一個投資人常聽的說法/網路熱門傳言，用真數據 + 統計檢定驗一次、可複現（呼應 AI 自主研究招牌）。boss 於 Telegram 定名；2026-07-06 boss 定：純前綴、不掛集數 EP.X。
myth_lab.membership_criteria: 投資人常聽的說法/網路傳言 + 真數據驗證；內部研究線代號多為 research_myth_* / newroute_*_myth。

excluded_dups.mile_19e264ee: VIX K1640 — same myth as mile_4d67163f (K1633); K1633 was the live one, kept; this one set to 'unpublished'.

daily_digest.definition: 每日一篇主題策展：選一 event-driven theme，從整庫撈 5-8 篇佐證串成敘事弧。是正式系列，但品牌化在前端。
daily_digest.frontend_component: frontend-v2-fix/src/components/DailyDigestSection.tsx (masthead 「每日精選導讀」+ 第 X 期 issueNumber + 編按 + 主圖 + 本期精選)
daily_digest.title_rule: 專題式標題，MUST NOT start with 每日精選導讀｜ (masthead already shows it — double-header).

member_qa.definition: 會員提問經 4 維度評分 → research → 回答文章。既有慣例。

event_thermometer.definition: 即期事件（FOMC / CPI / 非農 / 財報 / 重大宣告）的前後分析：事件前市場定位 vs 事件後實際反應，量『市場預期 vs 真實波動』的落差。boss 2026-07-06 定名。
event_thermometer.membership_criteria: timely event before/after analysis；權威標記 = details.event_series_slot（event_jobs slot）；going-forward 新 event_article 一律掛前綴。研究-about-events 的一般統計文章（如 K185 FOMC效應 / K617 台積電營收）不屬本系列。
event_thermometer.note: 帶 event_series_slot 標記者 4 篇（皆 published）已納入。更早的 event-flavored 文章（NFP/CPI 預告/盤後）未帶 marker → 未溯及品牌化；如需擴大 scope boss 指示即可。going-forward：event_article 發佈時把 id 加進 members_published 後跑 scripts/series_registry.py --apply。
